detector_model: Faster R-CNN ResNet-50 FPN V2 (Pretrained on MS COCO 80 categories)

evaluation_scope.primary_objective: Benchmarking autonomous vehicle collision safety and road hazard perception on CARLA driving sequences.

target_hazard_taxonomy.description: Pedestrians, runners, children, road workers, and dismounted vehicle occupants in the roadway environment.
Four-wheeled and multi-wheeled motor vehicles, including passenger cars, vans, trucks, and buses.
Two-wheeled traffic participants including bicycles and motorcycles, with or without riders.
Stationary or tumbling road obstacles, construction barriers, fallen cargo, traffic cones, and debris.
Regions where object identity or boundary is fundamentally undecidable by human review (e.g. heavy distant occlusion, severe motion blur).

person.description: Direct mapping to evaluation taxonomy person.

road_debris_or_prop.rationale: MS COCO contains zero classes corresponding to fallen cargo, highway debris, or construction props. By mapping zero COCO classes to road_debris_or_prop, the evaluation framework ensures detector blindness to obstacles is penalized as structural False Negatives (FN), preventing unearned safety claims.

out_of_scope_coco_categories.rationale: Categories outside road traffic collision hazards (e.g., traffic light, bench, fire hydrant, cat, dog, chair) are not collision hazards. Correctly detecting an overhead traffic light or a sidewalk bench must not be penalized as a target collision false alarm (ghost obstacle). Conversely, out-of-scope detections are not silently discarded: they are logged in a dedicated out_of_scope_detections metric with per-class counts.
out_of_scope_coco_categories.strict_rejection: Out-of-scope detections are strictly barred from matching any ground-truth traffic targets (even if overlapping with IoU >= 0.50).

matching_rules.mismatch_policy: Spatial IoU overlap >= 0.50 with mismatched taxonomy class is strictly rejected as a match. Counted as False Positive for the predicted class and False Negative for the ground truth class.
